'''Shinya Fukumatsu''' (Japanese: '''ふくまつ進紗''' ''Fukumatsu Shinya'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Fukumatsu was born on November 30, 1958, in what was once {{wp|Tokyo Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}. He started work on the {{pkmn|animated series}} with {{aniseries|BW}} as [[character of the day]] [[Dr. Ferrara]], before gaining his first notable role during {{aniseries|SM}} as {{an|Lillie}}'s butler [[Hobbes]]. Fukumatsu is currently affiliated with {{wp|Mausu Promotion}}.
